P_calibration.quote: Courts presume severability (Barr v. AAPC, 2020), so this matters less than it might appear.

P_grandfather_step.quote: It creates an incentive to formally start a long-running training run before enactment and continue it.

P_reliance_caveat.quote: Operating in reliance on aggressive readings is risky. This applies especially to the §3(c) safety-evaluation exception, offshore subsidiary structures, and run-splitting.
